other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Sikh community.
No family member should be a State/Central Government employee.
Neither the applicant nor any family member should have availed any loan/subsidy from the Corporation in the last 5 years, except for the Arivu Education Loan and Foreign Education Loan Scheme.
Applicant should not be a defaulter of the Corporation.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan of ₹50,000 with a matching subsidy of ₹50,000, and up to 33% subsidy (max ₹1,50,000) for vehicle purchase or up to ₹1,00,000 for self‑employment loans.
